title: depa celebrates success of coding Thailand 2026
description: The Ministry of Digital Economy and Society (MDES), through the Digital Economy Promotion Agency (depa), has announced the success of Coding Thailand 2026: AI Inspires the Future, a project aimed at promoting coding and artificial intelligence (AI) skills among Thai students and teachers nationwide. More than 12,000 students and teachers from across the country registered toparticipatein the project. After completing a series of learning activities and knowledge assessments, 3,224 participants from 806 teams were selected to take part in the regional competitions.
